maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from fuel card payment processing, interchange and fees, plus benefits administration and B2B payments, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Fleet fuel cards, HSA/benefits accounts and B2B payments are paid by private businesses, employers and consumers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through fleet card volume, benefits and payments; acquisitions like Sawatch Labs are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Fleet cards, benefits accounts (HSA/COBRA) and payments are embedded in operations; switching means reissuing cards and migrating accounts.
